definitions.gloss: candied dried baby sardines eaten at New Year
definitions.explanation: Small dried sardines toasted and coated in a sweet soy glaze, served in osechi. One of the three core celebratory dishes, eaten as a wish for a good harvest.

examples.english: Tazukuri takes its name from the use of small fish as fertilizer, and is regarded as a dish that wishes for a good harvest.

notes:
Literally "rice-field making," because dried sardines were once spread on fields as fertilizer. Also called ⟦ごまめ→ごまめ：30560_gomame⟧ in western Japan.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Together with ⟦{黒豆|くろまめ}→黒豆：30552_kuromame⟧ and ⟦{数|かず}の{子|こ}→数の子：30539_kazunoko⟧, {田作|たづく}り makes up the ⟦{祝|いわ}い{肴|ざかな}→祝い肴：30554_iwaizakana⟧{三種|さんしゅ} — the three dishes said to be enough, with rice cakes, to see in the New Year properly.
